rows.question: What happens when two cookies with the same name exist for different domains and I read one by name?
rows.answer: When you read a cookie by name from a RequestsCookieJar, the behavior depends on which method you use. The dict-style __getitem__ and the get() method both call _find_no_duplicates, which iterates over all cookies and raises a CookieConflictError if more than one cookie matches the given name (and optional domain/path), so two cookies with the same name for different domains will trigger a conflict error unless you disambiguate by passing domain or path (src/requests/cookies.py:423-456, src/requests/cookies.py:191-227).
